notes.title: Christmas update
notes.notes:
Dear friends, I congratulate you on the Coming 2019 Year!
I wish you success in all your endeavors)
And as a gift I present to your attention an update on the best game about cryptocurrency)

In this update you will find:
- Improved management. Attacking enemies can be on the left mouse button.
- Fixed a system of achievements.
- Many new achievements. Collect them all)
- It is snowing outside.
- The main character now wears a New Year's hat)
